::: {#fig-flowchart}

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
%%| fig-width: 8
%%| fig-cap: "Part 1: spectrum."

flowchart TD

%% ===== Setup =====
P[Load packages]

%% ===== Spectral stream  PHO modality =====
S_IMP[Import VEET spectral PHO data]
S_NORM[Normalize spectral counts with gain and integration time]
S_AGG[Aggregate spectral data to 5 minute bins and clean days]
S_CALMAT[Import calibration matrix for VEET]
S_RECON[Reconstruct spectra into Spectrum list column]
S_SAMPLE[Select one well covered day and compute illuminance]
S_PLOT1[Plot spectra colored by illuminance]
S_PLOT2[Ridgeline plot of spectra over time]

S_IMP --> S_NORM
S_NORM --> S_AGG
S_AGG --> S_RECON
S_CALMAT --> S_RECON
S_RECON --> S_SAMPLE
S_SAMPLE --> S_PLOT1
S_SAMPLE --> S_PLOT2

%% ===== Spectral metrics from reconstructed spectra =====
M_SHORTLONG[Short and long wavelength integrals and daily ratios]
M_MDER[Melanopic daylight efficacy ratio MDER]
M_MORNING[Morning short wavelength exposure 7 to 11]
M_HOURLY[Hourly profile of short wavelength exposure]
M_DAYNIGHT[Day versus night short wavelength exposure]

S_RECON --> M_SHORTLONG
M_SHORTLONG --> M_MDER
S_RECON --> M_MORNING
S_RECON --> M_HOURLY
S_RECON --> M_DAYNIGHT

```

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
%%| fig-width: 4
%%| fig-cap: "Part 2: distance."

flowchart TD

%% ===== Distance stream  TOF modality =====
D_IMP[Import VEET distance TOF data]
D_AGG[Aggregate distance to 10 second bins and clean days]
D_LONG[Pivot grid to long format one cell per row]
D_COORD[Derive x and y positions observation id and confidence percent]
D_PLOTFIELD[Spatial distance plot for one observation time]

D_IMP --> D_AGG
D_AGG --> D_LONG
D_LONG --> D_COORD
D_COORD --> D_PLOTFIELD

%% ===== Distance in region of interest and metrics =====
D_ROI[Reduce to central region of interest with high confidence]
D_DAY[Central distance time series for selected day]
DM_NEAR_DUR[Daily duration of near work]
DM_CONT_FREQ[Frequency of continuous near work episodes]
DM_CONT_PLOT[Plot of continuous near work episodes on distance series]

D_COORD --> D_ROI
D_ROI --> D_DAY
D_ROI --> DM_NEAR_DUR
D_ROI --> DM_CONT_FREQ
DM_CONT_FREQ --> DM_CONT_PLOT

```
